headline: Health Catalyst divesting non-core assets to focus on AI strategy; stock volatility reflects execution risk

signals.summary: Health Catalyst sold Vitalware product line to double down on AI-driven analytics strategy. This signals shift in product focus and potential organizational changes around priorities and budgets.
signals.suggestedAction: Monitor Health Catalyst's revised product roadmap and organizational structure over next quarter. Flag if their AI strategy creates demand for HIPAA-compliant email security for emerging use cases (e.g., patient AI-driven communications or app integrations).

headline: Health Catalyst undergoes major leadership transition with new CEO and board strengthening

signals.summary: Simeon Kohl appointed as CEO and President of Health Catalyst in September 2026. Kohl previously led a healthcare company through a $670M sale, signaling strong M&A and operational experience. Board strengthened simultaneously with appointment of Tami Reller.
signals.suggestedAction: Schedule a brief congratulations call or note with Simeon Kohl's office to re-introduce Paubox's healthcare email security and compliance solutions. New leadership often reviews vendor relationships; position as a trusted HIPAA-email partner for healthcare data protection.

signals.summary: Tami Reller appointed to Health Catalyst's board, adding senior healthcare leadership and governance oversight. No immediate operational impact on email/compliance tooling.
signals.suggestedAction: Monitor for any compliance or risk-management initiatives Reller may champion; be ready to support governance-driven email security and archiving reviews.
